verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a dedicated first-party server-side support page and a NullEngine class in its API reference, which is a non-rendering engine for running scene logic headless, e.g. in Node.js on servers. The pack gives only the page URLs, not their content, so details of the server workflow are implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: excerpted docs content showing how a dedicated-server build is set up, evidence that physics or game logic runs correctly under NullEngine, and independent or hands-on corroboration of server deployments.
